messages:
dana: Heads up — merchant sent a PO but the signer is the reseller (delegated signer). Portal rejected it due to signer entity mismatch. Rejection code: 422. Need PO reissue or signed delegation letter. @rachel can legal accept a redline? :warning:
liam: Ugh. They've got a deployment deadline EOD tomorrow. Is a manual attestation viable? We can accept a delegated-signature affidavit if legal ok.
rachel: Need copy of reseller delegation + original MSA. Can we get a CFO-signed PDF? Also need EIN verification. Send to legal@redwood.com.
tom: Finance: current invoice/PO format doesn't map to our ledger. If they reissue PO, include billing_entity_id and tax_jurisdiction fields. Example XML snippet:
```
<PO>
  <BillingEntityID>BE-12345</BillingEntityID>
  <TaxJurisdiction>US-CA</TaxJurisdiction>
</PO>
```
maya: I can update the marketplace connector to accept BillingEntityID as an alias tomorrow but need a sample file asap.
dana: @vendor-ops can you ask merchant to attach delegation affidavit and reissue PO before EOD? Offer temporary workaround: we can manually upload merchant-signed PO to portal to unblock provisioning.
vendor-bot: automated-validator: PO rejected - signer_entity_mismatch (code 422). See ticket #7891.
vendor-ops: Reached the merchant. They say their reseller signs under a standing reseller agreement. Will push CFO-signed affidavit + updated PO by noon PT.
liam: Great — rachel/tom can you confirm acceptance criteria so we can promise a timeline to the customer?
rachel: Legal will accept CFO-signed affidavit + copy of reseller agreement + MSA reference number. No additional redline required.
tom: Finance confirmed once PO includes BillingEntityID and TaxJurisdiction we can ingest automatically. Otherwise manual entry -> invoice delay ~2 weeks.
dana: Plan: vendor-ops gather docs, legal verify, finance confirm ingest path, eng (maya) prep connector tweak if needed. Please react with :thumbsup: when you have the task.
